title: How Much Does a Website Cost in Ireland? 2026 Prices in Euro
meta_title: How Much Does a Website Cost in Ireland? (2026, €)
meta_description: A small business website in Ireland costs about €500–€2,500 freelance and €2,500–€8,000+ from an agency. Online shop and running costs in euro.
keywords: how much does a website cost in ireland

faq.q: How much does a website cost in Ireland?
faq.a: Usually €500 to €2,500 from a freelancer and €2,500 to €8,000 or more from an agency for a small business site. Online shops cost more.

faq.q: Do Irish web designers charge VAT?
faq.a: VAT-registered businesses in Ireland add VAT at 23%. Always ask whether a quote includes it.

faq.q: How much does an online shop cost in Ireland?
faq.a: Typically €1,500 to €5,000 from a freelancer and €5,000 to €15,000 or more from an agency, plus platform and payment fees.

faq.q: Can a UK company build my Irish website?
faq.a: Yes. Many sites are built remotely. ContentFellow builds fixed-price sites for Irish clients from £349.

faq.q: Is there a grant for websites in Ireland?
faq.a: The Trading Online Voucher from Local Enterprise Offices has supported online trading projects. Check current eligibility with your local office.
